title: This sub just showed up on my feed and I'm still floored by the idea of it.
content: Okay, so my recurring "dream mall" seems to be one of those things where I never visit the same place twice, yet no matter how many times I dream the place there's a subconscious awareness that it's the same mall every time. Well... to temper that, I *may* visit the same place twice... within the same dream. If it's ever happened in separate dreams it's rare enough that I simply don't remember repeat visits. &#x200B; It is *not* a mall I remember ever visiting in my waking life. &#x200B; The shape of it, from what I can remember of dreams I've had so far, is an H or kind of a pixelated-eight--the hallway right through the center contains a movie theater and thus far is the only way I'm sure of to get from one section of the mall to another without going outside. The mall has at least two floors but I've only ever crossed levels via stores that exist on both, never in the main mall itself. I'm not sure what all types of stores exist but I do remember visiting a video game store (one which contains some very legacy hardware as well as stuff that probably hasn't even been invented yet) as well as a bookshop; the bookshop is one of the ones that exists on two floors. I know I've visited other stores, I just don't remember what at the time I'm writing this. &#x200B; Probably the weirdest part of the dream, at least when comparing it to reality, is I remember one time having to enter the mall by ducking under the area designated solely for bringing in stray carts. &#x200B; Finally, with the possible exception of what type of stuff is available for sale (see above about the video game store), there's nothing otherworldly about this mall... it resembles something that might already exist somewhere nearby that I just haven't encountered yet. &#x200B; (I also have recurring dreams of visiting a book store to look for different titles--sometimes a fancy-ish store in a strip mall on par with B&N, sometimes a used book shop that looks like someone converted their barn for the purpose--but these dreams, which do involve repeat visits, are separate from this mall.)
